name: Coronary Artery Disease & Heart Attack
description: Atherosclerotic narrowing or blockage of coronary arteries causing angina, ischemia, or myocardial infarction (heart attack).

procedures.name: Angioplasty (PTCA with Drug-Eluting Stents)
procedures.aarogyasri_status: Covered up to ₹1,50,000 under White Card
procedures.sublimits_notes: No sublimit on Angioplasty in comprehensive policies; subject to room rent capping and consumable non-payables.
procedures.official_source: NHA PM-JAY Master Tariff & CGHS 2025 Tariff Schedule Code S12

procedures.name: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG)
procedures.sublimits_notes: ICU stay and cardiothoracic theatre covered; subject to room rent limits.
procedures.official_source: National Health Authority Cardiology Package Schedule

name: Osteoarthritis & Degenerative Joint Disease
description: Progressive degradation of articular cartilage causing joint pain, stiffness, and severe mobility limitations in knee and hip joints.

procedures.name: Total Knee Replacement (Single Joint)
procedures.aarogyasri_status: Covered in government & empanelled trust hospitals
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: Specific Disease Waiting Period (24 months mandatory in almost all Indian health policies)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Implant capped per NPPA pricing guidelines. Some basic policies cap joint replacement at ₹1.5L - ₹2.0L.
procedures.official_source: NPPA Knee Implant Ceiling Order & CGHS Tariff 2025

procedures.name: Total Hip Replacement (THR)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Covered under comprehensive plans after 24 months; implant costs subject to ceiling.

name: Malignant Neoplasms & Oncology
description: Abnormal malignant cellular proliferation requiring chemotherapy, targeted immunotherapy, radiotherapy, or surgical resection.

procedures.name: Chemotherapy & Targeted Immunotherapy (Per Cycle)
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period (Zero waiting period if cancer develops after 30-day initial period)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Oral chemotherapy and immunotherapy covered under Modern Treatment sublimits in older policies; fully covered in Optima Secure & ReAssure 2.0.

procedures.name: Radiation Therapy (IMRT / IGRT / CyberKnife)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Modern stereotactic and robotic radiation covered under IRDAI modern treatments guideline.

name: End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) & Chronic Kidney Disease
description: Complete loss of renal clearance function requiring regular hemodialysis filtration or allograft renal transplantation.

procedures.name: Hemodialysis (Per Session)
procedures.aarogyasri_status: 100% Free under Telangana Aarogyasri Dialysis Centers
procedures.sublimits_notes: Daycare hemodialysis covered up to Sum Insured; peritoneal dialysis consumables covered in select plans.
procedures.official_source: National Dialysis Programme Guidelines & PM-JAY Tariff

procedures.name: Renal (Kidney) Transplantation
procedures.pmjay_status: Covered subject to state organ authorization clearance
procedures.aarogyasri_status: Covered up to ₹10 Lakh ceiling with Jeevandan registration
procedures.sublimits_notes: Donor harvesting hospitalization covered up to base Sum Insured; immunosuppressants covered under post-hospitalization.
non_payable_items: HLA tissue crossmatch specialized antibody panels
Donor evaluation diagnostic workup outside hospitalization
procedures.official_source: Jeevandan Telangana & NHA Organ Transplant Protocols

name: Cerebrovascular Stroke & Neurological Trauma
description: Acute interruption of cerebral arterial perfusion causing ischemic cerebral infarction or intracranial hemorrhage.

procedures.name: Acute Ischemic Stroke Thrombolysis & Neuro-ICU Care
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: None (Emergency life-threatening admission covered after standard 30-day initial period)
procedures.sublimits_notes: tPA thrombolytic medication covered under medicine charges; mechanical thrombectomy covered in modern treatments.

name: Senile Cataract & Visual Impairment
description: Opacification of the natural crystalline lens causing progressive visual loss and glare, treated via phacoemulsification and IOL implantation.

procedures.name: Cataract Surgery (Phacoemulsification with Foldable IOL)
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: Specific Disease Waiting Period (24 months standard)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Frequently capped at ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per eye depending on policy sum insured. No sublimit in HDFC Optima Secure and Niva Bupa ReAssure.
procedures.official_source: National Programme for Control of Blindness & CGHS Tariff 2025

name: Pregnancy & Obstetric Delivery Care
description: Antenatal care, intrapartum labor management, and postpartum maternal-neonatal recovery.

procedures.name: Normal Vaginal Delivery
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: Maternity Waiting Period (24-36 months on policies with maternity cover)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Excluded in basic health policies; covered in Star Comprehensive (up to ₹30,000) and ICICI Lombard AdvantEdge (up to ₹50,000). Excluded in HDFC Optima Secure.
procedures.official_source: Janani Suraksha Yojana & State Health Guidelines

procedures.name: Cesarean Section (C-Section Delivery)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Covered up to ₹50,000 in policies featuring maternity rider.
procedures.official_source: Telangana Health Directorate Maternal Care Protocols

name: Acute Abdominal Conditions & Hernia
description: Common general surgical interventions for abdominal wall herniation, acute appendicitis, and symptomatic cholelithiasis (gallstones).

procedures.name: Laparoscopic Appendectomy
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: None (Acute emergency appendicitis covered post 30-day initial period)
procedures.sublimits_notes: No sublimit; covered under general surgery inpatient benefits.

procedures.name: Laparoscopic Inguinal / Umbilical Hernia Repair with Mesh
procedures.insurance_waiting_period_type: Specific Disease Waiting Period (24 months standard)
procedures.sublimits_notes: Polypropylene mesh covered up to standard market benchmarks.
procedures.official_source: Association of Surgeons of India & CGHS Tariff 2025
